patterns.note: Prominent full-width hero section followed by a grid of circular category icons, creating a visually distinct entry point before standard product grids.
Extensive use of uniform product grids with consistent image sizing and minimal text overlay, maintaining a clean and uncluttered product display.
A top promotional banner collapses out of view as the main navigation bar becomes sticky and slightly more compact on scroll, optimizing screen real estate.
A consistent palette of muted, natural tones for product photography against clean white backgrounds, punctuated by a warm, soft orange accent for calls to action and highlights.
Editorial-style content blocks ('Look to Quince...') are interspersed between product grids, using full-bleed imagery and concise, lifestyle-oriented text to break up product listings.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that activates after an initial scroll, where a top promotional banner slides away, and the main navigation bar docks to the top of the viewport, slightly reducing its vertical padding. This uses CSS transitions for a smooth effect.

Product displays utilize a responsive grid system, presenting items with consistent square or portrait aspect ratio images and minimal product details directly below, often with a subtle hover effect for quick views.
Category navigation is presented as a horizontal scrollable carousel of circular image icons, each representing a product category, allowing for a visually engaging and space-efficient way to browse.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced sans-serif type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, and many labels are set in smaller uppercase for a clean, editorial feel.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and some product image containers, with distinct circular shapes for category icons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero and category sections, transitioning to a more dense but still clean grid for product displays, maintaining good visual breathing room.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated, editorial presentation of products, using high-quality photography and a clean, spacious layout that feels more like a lifestyle magazine than a typical e-commerce store. The integration of circular category navigation and subtle, full-bleed content blocks creates a distinctive, curated shopping experience.
